name: Yushu Shang de Lizhi Hua
source:
Youth is a chapter of poetry that can never be revisited but will always remain sealed in the depths of memory.

With dreams and hopes for the future, you step into an international high school filled with stories. Here, you meet three boys with distinct personalities: the aloof and profound senior, the gentle and wise scholar, and the sunny and passionate childhood friend.

Amid encounters and farewells with them, you experience the thrill of love, the trials of friendship, and the warmth of family.

Youth is also an old music box, spinning as it plays that familiar song.

Are you ready?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672040/]Steam[/url]]
